comment: The twelve named launchers (docs/specs/workspace-launch-and-open.md, Twelve launchers). scripts/vm-launchers-lib.sh and scripts/vm-prepare-launchers.sh read this; later increments reuse the inventory it yields. `install.via` is cask (Homebrew Cask, quarantined by Homebrew as a download), vendor-zip (the vendor's own current download, quarantined by hand as a browser would) or system (ships with macOS). `windowApp` is the name the accessibility tree gives the application's windows. `dialogs` are the application's own first-run buttons, pressed by label, and `quitDialogs` those it asks when quitting; the ones every application can raise (Gatekeeper's Open, a system permission request, an Accessibility-events request) are in scripts/vm-launchers-lib.sh. `launches` (default 1) is how many times its first run must be opened before it has asked everything; `resting` lists buttons that stay on its window in the state first run stops at (they are not questions awaiting an answer); `reaches` is where its first run stops without an account. `gatekeeperPending` marks the one application whose pristine quarantined copy is kept aside, as an archive, for the Gatekeeper-pending case.

apps.name: Dia
apps.reaches: intro film, then a work-email gate (never filled in)

apps.name: Jump Desktop

install.reason: the Homebrew cask is pinned to 9.1.9 (April 2025), which aborts at launch on macOS 26 (NSTitlebarAccessoryViewController assertion in an Apple Event handler); the vendor's current download runs

apps.reaches: empty computer list with a trial banner

dialogs.what: session-ended warning (a shell that ended soon after starting)
update-check question, asked from the second launch on

quitDialogs.what: confirm quitting with a session open

apps.name: Mail
apps.reaches: read-only inbox window behind an Add Account sheet, which stays on every launch and whose Cancel quits Mail

apps.name: Zotero
apps.reaches: library window; also opens its welcome page in the default browser (Safari)
